Jak działa XOXO Avenue

Prosty sposób na poznawanie ludzi we własnym tempie.

1

Przeglądaj publiczne posty

Zobacz dostępne publiczne posty i dowiedz się, czym dzielą się inni.

2

Znajduj ludzi

Skorzystaj z Discover i wyszukiwarki, aby znaleźć osoby o podobnych zainteresowaniach.

3

Dołącz do rozmowy

Załóż bezpłatne konto, uzupełnij profil, publikuj posty i kontaktuj się z innymi.

Znajdź znajomych o podobnych zainteresowaniach

Muzyka, gry, języki, podróże i poznawanie osób z innych krajów — wspólne pasje mogą być początkiem nowych przyjaźni.

Odkrywaj przed rejestracją

Sekcje publiczne pozwalają poznać XOXO Avenue i dostępne publiczne treści. Rejestracja jest wymagana do publikowania, komentowania i wysyłania prywatnych wiadomości.

Nawiązuj kontakty bezpiecznie

Poznawaj ludzi stopniowo. Nie publikuj prywatnych danych kontaktowych ani poufnych informacji. Szanuj granice innych i korzystaj z Pomocy, gdy jej potrzebujesz.

How to use Discover

Choose a platform, language or interest to narrow your search. Combine filters when you have something specific in mind, or clear them to explore more broadly.

Find your kind of connection

Looking for new friends, gaming partners, study buddies or a language exchange? Use the “Looking for” filter to discover posts that fit your goals. Results depend on what members have shared.

Understanding public posts

Discover shows public posts shared by members. You can explore a limited selection before signing up. Profiles and posts reflect what their authors choose to share; not every filter will have matching results.

Tips for meaningful connections

Start with a friendly introduction and a shared interest. Respect other people's boundaries, avoid sharing sensitive personal details, and use the available support or reporting options if something concerns you.

Cómo utilizar Discover

Elige una plataforma, un idioma o un interés para precisar tu búsqueda. Combina filtros si buscas algo específico o bórralos para explorar más opciones.

Encuentra el tipo de conexión que buscas

¿Buscas nuevas amistades, compañeros de videojuegos, de estudio o de intercambio de idiomas? Utiliza el filtro «Qué buscas» para descubrir publicaciones relacionadas. Los resultados dependen de lo que compartan los miembros.

Comprende las publicaciones públicas

Discover muestra publicaciones públicas de los miembros. Puedes explorar una selección limitada antes de registrarte. Los perfiles y las publicaciones reflejan lo que sus autores deciden compartir; algunos filtros pueden no mostrar resultados.

Consejos para conectar mejor

Empieza con un saludo amable y un interés en común. Respeta los límites de los demás, evita compartir datos personales sensibles y utiliza las opciones de soporte o denuncia disponibles si algo te preocupa.

Como usar o Discover

Escolha uma plataforma, um idioma ou um interesse para refinar sua busca. Combine filtros para encontrar algo específico ou limpe-os para explorar mais opções.

Encontre o tipo de conexão que procura

Quer fazer amizades, encontrar parceiros de jogos, estudos ou troca de idiomas? Use o filtro “O que procura” para descobrir publicações relacionadas. Os resultados dependem do que os membros compartilham.

Entenda as publicações públicas

O Discover mostra publicações públicas dos membros. Você pode explorar uma seleção limitada antes de se cadastrar. Perfis e publicações refletem o que seus autores escolhem compartilhar; alguns filtros podem não retornar resultados.

Dicas para criar boas conexões

Comece com uma apresentação simpática e um interesse em comum. Respeite os limites dos outros, evite compartilhar dados pessoais sensíveis e use as opções disponíveis de suporte ou denúncia se algo preocupar você.

Comment utiliser Discover

Choisissez une plateforme, une langue ou un centre d’intérêt pour affiner votre recherche. Combinez les filtres pour une recherche précise ou réinitialisez-les pour explorer davantage.

Trouvez le type de lien qui vous correspond

Vous cherchez des amis, des partenaires de jeu, de révision ou d’échange linguistique ? Utilisez le filtre « Je recherche » pour découvrir des publications adaptées. Les résultats dépendent des contenus partagés par les membres.

Comprendre les publications publiques

Discover présente les publications publiques des membres. Vous pouvez en explorer une sélection limitée avant de vous inscrire. Les profils et publications reflètent ce que leurs auteurs choisissent de partager ; certains filtres peuvent ne donner aucun résultat.

Conseils pour créer de vrais liens

Commencez par une présentation chaleureuse et un intérêt commun. Respectez les limites de chacun, évitez de divulguer des données personnelles sensibles et utilisez les options d’assistance ou de signalement disponibles en cas de problème.

Jak korzystać z Discover

Wybierz platformę, język lub zainteresowania, aby zawęzić wyszukiwanie. Łącz filtry, gdy szukasz czegoś konkretnego, albo wyczyść je, aby zobaczyć więcej możliwości.

Znajdź znajomości, których szukasz

Szukasz przyjaciół, partnerów do gier, nauki lub wymiany językowej? Użyj filtra „Czego szukasz”, aby odkryć odpowiednie posty. Wyniki zależą od treści udostępnionych przez użytkowników.

Zrozum publiczne posty

Discover wyświetla publiczne posty użytkowników. Przed rejestracją możesz obejrzeć ograniczony wybór treści. Profile i posty zawierają informacje udostępnione przez autorów; nie wszystkie filtry muszą zwracać wyniki.

Wskazówki dotyczące dobrych znajomości

Zacznij od miłego przywitania i wspólnego zainteresowania. Szanuj granice innych, nie udostępniaj wrażliwych danych osobowych i korzystaj z dostępnych opcji pomocy lub zgłaszania problemów, jeśli coś Cię niepokoi.

✨ About XOXO Avenue

About XOXO Avenue

Discover people. Explore communities. Make meaningful connections.

💫

Discover people. Explore communities. Make meaningful connections.

XOXO Avenue is an independent social discovery platform where people can meet others, share interests, explore communities and build friendships.

🌎

Discover people around the world

Explore public posts and use search tools to discover people who share your interests. You can explore public sections without an account; participating in member-only features requires registration.

✨

Create your space

Create a personal profile, share posts, and connect through likes, comments and reposts. Your profile helps other members learn about your interests.

💬

Explore connections and communities

Find posts related to WhatsApp, Telegram, Snapchat and other interests. XOXO Avenue helps people discover connections; it does not operate third-party messaging services.

🔎

Explore before you join

Visitors can read public information and available public posts. Creating an account is free and unlocks member-only participation, including private messaging.

🛡️

Connect respectfully and safely

Respect others, protect personal information and avoid sharing sensitive details with strangers. Private conversations are not displayed in public discovery. Visit Support if you need help.

💜

Growing together

XOXO Avenue is a developing community. Real posts, shared interests and genuine interactions help make it more useful for everyone.

ℹ️

Independent platform

XOXO Avenue is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by WhatsApp, Telegram, Snapchat or Discord. Please review our Privacy Policy, Terms of Service and Community Guidelines.

✨ Acerca de XOXO Avenue

Acerca de XOXO Avenue

Descubre personas. Explora comunidades. Crea conexiones auténticas.

💫

Descubre personas. Explora comunidades. Crea conexiones auténticas.

XOXO Avenue es una plataforma independiente de descubrimiento social donde puedes conocer personas, compartir intereses, explorar comunidades y crear amistades.

🌎

Descubre personas de todo el mundo

Explora publicaciones públicas y utiliza las herramientas de búsqueda para descubrir personas con intereses similares. Puedes visitar las secciones públicas sin una cuenta; para participar en funciones exclusivas debes registrarte.

✨

Crea tu propio espacio

Crea tu perfil personal, comparte publicaciones e interactúa mediante Me gusta, comentarios y republicaciones. Tu perfil ayuda a otros miembros a conocer tus intereses.

💬

Explora conexiones y comunidades

Encuentra publicaciones relacionadas con WhatsApp, Telegram, Snapchat y otros intereses. XOXO Avenue facilita descubrir conexiones, pero no administra servicios de mensajería de terceros.

🔎

Explora antes de unirte

Los visitantes pueden leer información y publicaciones públicas disponibles. Crear una cuenta es gratis y permite participar en funciones para miembros, incluidos los mensajes privados.

🛡️

Conecta con respeto y seguridad

Respeta a los demás, protege tu información personal y evita compartir datos sensibles con desconocidos. Las conversaciones privadas no aparecen en Discover. Visita Soporte si necesitas ayuda.

💜

Crecemos juntos

XOXO Avenue es una comunidad en desarrollo. Las publicaciones reales, los intereses compartidos y las interacciones auténticas ayudan a mejorar la experiencia para todos.

ℹ️

Plataforma independiente

XOXO Avenue no está afiliada, respaldada ni patrocinada por WhatsApp, Telegram, Snapchat o Discord. Consulta nuestra Política de privacidad, Términos de servicio y Normas de la comunidad.

Découvrez des personnes. Explorez des communautés. Créez de vrais liens.

XOXO Avenue est une plateforme indépendante de découverte sociale où vous pouvez rencontrer des personnes, partager vos centres d’intérêt, explorer des communautés et nouer des amitiés.

🌎

Découvrez des personnes du monde entier

Explorez les publications publiques et utilisez les outils de recherche pour découvrir des personnes partageant vos centres d’intérêt. Les sections publiques sont accessibles sans compte ; l’inscription est nécessaire pour participer aux fonctionnalités réservées aux membres.

Créez votre espace

Créez un profil personnel, partagez des publications et interagissez grâce aux mentions J’aime, aux commentaires et aux republications. Votre profil permet aux autres membres de découvrir vos centres d’intérêt.

Échangez avec respect et prudence

Respectez les autres, protégez vos données personnelles et évitez de communiquer des informations sensibles à des inconnus. Les conversations privées ne figurent pas dans la découverte publique. Contactez l’assistance si nécessaire.

Grandissons ensemble

O XOXO Avenue

Poznawaj ludzi. Odkrywaj społeczności. Nawiązuj prawdziwe relacje.

💫

Poznawaj ludzi. Odkrywaj społeczności. Nawiązuj prawdziwe relacje.

XOXO Avenue to niezależna platforma społecznościowa, na której możesz poznawać ludzi, dzielić się zainteresowaniami, odkrywać społeczności i nawiązywać przyjaźnie.

🌎

Poznawaj ludzi z całego świata

Przeglądaj publiczne posty i korzystaj z wyszukiwarki, aby odkrywać osoby o podobnych zainteresowaniach. Publiczne sekcje są dostępne bez konta; udział w funkcjach dla członków wymaga rejestracji.

✨

Stwórz własną przestrzeń

Utwórz profil, publikuj posty i reaguj polubieniami, komentarzami oraz udostępnieniami. Twój profil pomaga innym poznać Twoje zainteresowania.

💬

Odkrywaj kontakty i społeczności

Znajduj posty związane z WhatsAppem, Telegramem, Snapchatem i innymi zainteresowaniami. XOXO Avenue pomaga odkrywać kontakty, ale nie prowadzi zewnętrznych komunikatorów.

🔎

Poznaj serwis przed rejestracją

Goście mogą czytać dostępne informacje i publiczne posty. Założenie konta jest bezpłatne i umożliwia korzystanie z funkcji dla członków, w tym prywatnych wiadomości.

🛡️

Dbaj o szacunek i bezpieczeństwo

Szanuj innych, chroń swoje dane osobowe i nie udostępniaj poufnych informacji nieznajomym. Prywatne rozmowy nie pojawiają się w publicznej sekcji odkrywania. W razie potrzeby skorzystaj z Pomocy.

💜

Rozwijamy się razem

XOXO Avenue to rozwijająca się społeczność. Prawdziwe posty, wspólne zainteresowania i autentyczne interakcje pomagają tworzyć lepsze miejsce dla wszystkich.

ℹ️

Niezależna platforma

XOXO Avenue nie jest powiązana z WhatsAppem, Telegramem, Snapchatem ani Discordem i nie jest przez nie sponsorowana ani wspierana. Zapoznaj się z Polityką prywatności, Regulaminem i Zasadami społeczności.

Privacy Policy

How XOXO Avenue handles information when you use the service.

Last updated: October 21, 2026

1. About this Privacy Policy

XOXO Avenue is a social discovery platform that helps people meet others, make friends and discover communities. This Privacy Policy explains the types of information XOXO Avenue handles and how that information is used to provide and protect the service.

2. Information you provide

When you create or use a XOXO Avenue account, you may provide information such as your email address, username and profile information. Depending on what you choose to add to your profile, this may include your age, country, languages, interests, what you are looking for, profile photo, bio, gender identity and sexual orientation.

Your exact age is treated as private profile information and is not displayed as part of your public XOXO Avenue profile. Other profile information you choose to provide may be used to help people discover your profile and connect with you.

3. Content and activity

XOXO Avenue handles content and activity you create on the service, including posts, comments, replies, photos, videos, likes, follows, mentions and other interactions. Content you post for the XOXO Avenue community may be visible to other users.

XOXO Avenue also supports saved posts, blocking and reporting. Saved posts are private to your account. Blocking information is used to apply your blocking choices. Reports are used to help review safety or community concerns.

4. Private messages

XOXO Avenue allows users to send direct messages and supported media to one another. Direct messages are intended to be private between the sender and recipient and are handled separately from public posts.

5. How XOXO Avenue uses information

Information may be used to operate XOXO Avenue, authenticate accounts, display profiles and content, provide search and discovery features, deliver messages and notifications, remember user choices, support social features such as follows and likes, respond to reports, prevent abuse, troubleshoot problems and improve the reliability and safety of the service.

6. Public and private information

Some XOXO Avenue features are designed for sharing and discovery. For example, information you choose to include in your discoverable profile, posts, comments and community-related content may be visible to other users. Private features, such as saved posts and direct messages, are handled with access controls appropriate to those features.

Before posting personal information, photos, videos, group links or other content, consider whether you are comfortable sharing it with the people who may be able to view that content.

7. Media and external links

XOXO Avenue allows users to share supported media and may allow links to communities or services such as WhatsApp, Telegram, Snapchat or Discord. If you follow a link to another service, that service has its own privacy practices and terms. XOXO Avenue does not control how an external service handles information after you leave XOXO Avenue.

8. Service providers and infrastructure

XOXO Avenue uses third-party technology and infrastructure to operate the service, including Supabase for application services such as account, database and storage functionality, and Cloudflare for web hosting and delivery. Information necessary to operate XOXO Avenue may therefore be processed through these service providers as part of providing the service.

9. Security

XOXO Avenue uses technical access controls and other reasonable measures intended to protect account information and private features. No online service can guarantee absolute security, so users should also protect their passwords and be careful about the information they choose to share.

10. Age requirements

XOXO Avenue is intended for people aged 13 and older. XOXO Avenue does not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If XOXO Avenue becomes aware that an account belongs to a child under 13, appropriate steps may be taken regarding the account and associated information.

You can choose what optional profile information and content to share, use XOXO Avenue's blocking and reporting tools, and contact XOXO Avenue Support with questions about your account or information. If you want to request assistance concerning your account or data, contact the support address below.

XOXO Avenue may update this Privacy Policy as the service changes. When the policy is updated, the date at the top of this page may be revised.

Questions about this Privacy Policy or your XOXO Avenue account can be sent to xoxoavenuesupport@gmail.com.

XOXO Avenue may introduce advertising in the future to support the service while keeping its core features free. Google AdSense is being considered, but this notice does not mean Google ads are currently active.

XOXO Avenue and its service providers may use cookies, browser storage and similar technologies to support sign-in sessions, security, preferences and website functionality.

If advertising services are introduced, additional technologies may be used for ad delivery, measurement and fraud prevention. Where legally required, appropriate consent will be requested before non-essential advertising technologies are used. Browser settings may also provide controls over cookies, although disabling some technologies may affect site functionality.

16. Analytics and optional measurement

With your permission, XOXO Avenue uses Google Analytics to measure visits to selected public pages. Analytics is optional and is not activated before you choose to allow it. The implementation does not intentionally send private messages, profile identifiers, or URL query parameters to Google Analytics. Google may process device and usage information under its own policies. To change your choice, use the Analytics privacy settings link below.

These external controls do not replace any consent or privacy options that XOXO Avenue may be legally required to provide directly.

18. International Visitors and Privacy Rights

Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have rights to request access to, correction of or deletion of personal information, or to object to or restrict certain processing. Where processing relies on consent, you may have the right to withdraw that consent.

19. Advertising and Younger Users

XOXO Avenue is intended for users aged 13 and older. Before enabling advertising, XOXO Avenue will evaluate and apply relevant protections for minors, including restrictions on personalized advertising where required. Sensitive profile information, such as sexual orientation or gender identity, will not be intentionally used by XOXO Avenue to target advertisements.

20. Data retention and deletion

Different categories of account data and content may be retained for different periods depending on service operations, safety needs and applicable law. No single deletion deadline is promised. Community Guidelines

Help keep XOXO Avenue welcoming, respectful and safe.

Last updated: October 21, 2026

Be respectful

Treat other people with respect. Harassment, bullying, threats and targeted abuse are not welcome on XOXO Avenue.

Keep XOXO Avenue safe

Do not use XOXO Avenue to promote or coordinate illegal activity, scams, sexual exploitation, credible threats of violence or other activity that puts people at serious risk.

No spam or deceptive accounts

Do not repeatedly send unwanted content, manipulate interactions, impersonate another person or create accounts intended to deceive or harm others.

Respect privacy

Do not publish another person's private or sensitive information without permission. Think carefully before sharing your own contact information or other personal details publicly.

Share responsibly

You are responsible for the posts, comments, photos, videos, messages and links you share. Share content you have the right to share and consider who may be able to see it.

No sexually explicit content

Do not post pornography, sexually explicit images or videos, or content intended to depict explicit sexual activity. Do not use XOXO Avenue to solicit or distribute sexual exploitation material. This applies to posts, profiles, comments, messages, media and shared links.

No graphic violence or glorification of harm

Do not share extremely graphic violence, gore, or content that promotes, celebrates or encourages serious physical harm. Threats and incitement to violence are prohibited.

Protect children and teenagers

Any sexual exploitation, grooming, sexualization or abuse of minors is strictly prohibited. Never request, create, share or link to child sexual abuse material. Do not target younger users with sexual solicitations or predatory behavior. Serious safety concerns may be reported to appropriate authorities as required by law.

Respect copyright and intellectual property

Only share photos, videos, music, text and other content that you own or are authorized to use. Do not upload pirated material or content that infringes another person's copyright or other intellectual property rights. Rights holders may contact XOXO Avenue Support regarding suspected infringement.

Use Block and Report

XOXO Avenue includes tools for blocking users and reporting concerns. Use these tools when appropriate to help protect your experience and bring possible rule violations to XOXO Avenue's attention.

Be careful with external communities

XOXO Avenue can help people discover communities and connections on services such as WhatsApp, Telegram, Snapchat and Discord. External groups are not controlled by XOXO Avenue. Be careful with unfamiliar links, requests for personal information and people you have only met online.

Enforcement

XOXO Avenue may review reports and may remove content, restrict features or take action on accounts when activity violates these Guidelines, the Terms of Service or creates a significant safety concern.

Help build a good community

XOXO Avenue is about meeting people, making friends, and discovering communities. Help us keep it welcoming, respectful, and safe for everyone. 💙

Contact

Questions or safety concerns can be sent to xoxoavenuesupport@gmail.com.

Where these rules apply

These Guidelines apply to public posts, profiles, comments, direct messages, media and other interactions on XOXO Avenue, as relevant to each feature.

Reports and review requests

Use available Block and Report tools to raise concerns. XOXO Avenue may remove content or restrict accounts when necessary. If you believe a moderation decision was mistaken, contact xoxoavenuesupport@gmail.com with relevant details to request a review. A specific result cannot be guaranteed.
